text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet as EXCAVA’s core reasoning engine. It’s the most capable model available today, and we’ve already validated its performance in blind tests—no other model closes the gap. The trade-off is cost: Sonnet is expensive, but a 0.5% capability bump justifies it if it unlocks even 1% more efficiency in downstream tasks.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s the 2x spike eroding margin on every run, and Anthropic’s pricing isn’t stable. A better alternative: run a blind A/B test comparing Sonnet against the next-tier open model (like Llama 3.3 70B) on EXCAVA’s actual task mix; if Sonnet wins by ≥0.5% on the primary metric, adopt it—otherwise, default to the cheaper model. Settle the argument with a week of live traffic data, not hand-waved benchmarks.
